theorem raft_dyn_alloc_boot [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (E : CoPset) (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (h0
    : CfgOk c0) (ids : GSet w64) (ccOk : w32 → List w8 → Prop) (bootLog : List EntryM) (C :
    RaftNames → IProp GF) (ns nx : Bool) : ¬W64 0 ∈ ids → bootLog ≠ [] → BootWf ccOk bootLog → ⊢
    allocClientGen E c0.cfg.incoming (some (DynCfg.ofFold dec c0 h0).all) ccOk bootLog C ={E}=∗ ∃ γ,
    ⌜γ.dyn = some (DynCfg.ofFold dec c0 h0) ∧ γ.reCCOk = ccOk ∧ γ.reCfg = c0.cfg.incoming ∧ γ.reBoot
    = bootLog ∧ γ.reNoSnap = ns ∧ γ.reNoXfer = nx⌝ ∗ raftCommitInv γ ∗ C γ ∗ ([∗map] id ↦ _u ∈ toMap
    ids, ownRaftGhostR γ dec c0 id (rboot c0 bootLog)) ∗ isCommitted γ bootLog ∗ rdCred γ (2 ^ 64 -
    2) ∗ rdCredInv γ

def rboot (c0 : CCState) (bootLog : List EntryM) : RState :=
  { p := bootPState bootLog, applied := W64 0, pci := W64 0, snap := false, cidx := 0, cfg := c0, fp := [] }

theorem RInv_rinit (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState) : RInv dec c0 (rinit c0)

def rinit (c0 : CCState) : RState :=
  { p := initPState, applied := W64 0, pci := W64 0, snap := false, cidx := 0, cfg := c0, fp := [] }

theorem RInv_rboot (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (bootLog : List EntryM) (hL : ↑bootLog.length < 2 ^
    64) : RInv dec c0 (rboot c0 bootLog)

theorem raft_dyn_alloc [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (E : CoPset) (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (h0 :
    CfgOk c0) (ids : GSet w64) (ccOk : w32 → List w8 → Prop) (C : RaftNames → IProp GF) : ¬W64 0 ∈
    ids → ⊢ allocClient E c0.cfg.incoming (some (DynCfg.ofFold dec c0 h0).all) C ={E}=∗ ∃ γ, ⌜γ.dyn
    = some (DynCfg.ofFold dec c0 h0) ∧ γ.reCCOk = ccOk ∧ γ.reCfg = c0.cfg.incoming ∧ γ.reNoXfer =
    false⌝ ∗ raftCommitInv γ ∗ C γ ∗ ([∗map] id ↦ _u ∈ toMap ids, ownRaftGhostR γ dec c0 id (rinit
    c0)) ∗ isCommitted γ [] ∗ rdCred γ (2 ^ 64 - 2) ∗ rdCredInv γ
